patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making or letting someone else do it. おぼえる is 'learn', so おぼえさせますか = 'will you make it learn?', that is, 'teach it?'

patterns.name: 〜ますか
patterns.explanation: か at the end of a polite verb turns it into a question. おぼえさせますか = 'will you make it learn?'
